background_jobs.baseline_ddl:
id bigint NOT NULL,
    public_id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    job_key text NOT NULL,
    kind text NOT NULL,
    lane text DEFAULT 'default'::text NOT NULL,
    state text DEFAULT 'queued'::text NOT NULL,
    attempts integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    error_message text,
    lease_token bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    lease_expires_at timestamp with time zone,
    claimed_at timestamp with time zone,
    attempt_deadline_at timestamp with time zone,
    question_deadline_at timestamp with time zone,
    completion_operation text,
    completion_payload jsonb,
    next_run_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    redrive_count integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    safe_error_code text,
    CONSTRAINT agent_question_deadline CHECK (((kind = 'agent_question'::text) = (question_deadline_at IS NOT NULL))),
    CONSTRAINT background_jobs_lease_token_check CHECK ((lease_token >= 0)),
    CONSTRAINT background_jobs_state_check CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'running'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'retry_wait'::text, 'repair_required'::text, 'dead'::text, 'cancelled'::text]))),
    CONSTRAINT job_completion_pair CHECK (((completion_operation IS NULL) = (completion_payload IS NULL))),
    CONSTRAINT job_lease_state CHECK ((((state = 'running'::text) AND (lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (claimed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_deadline_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((state <> 'running'::text) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL) AND (claimed_at IS NULL) AND (attempt_deadline_at IS NULL))))

target_id.declaration: BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (COALESCE(DOCUMENT_TARGET_ID, QUEST_TARGET_ID, CHARACTER_TARGET_ID, REGION_TARGET_ID)) STORED NOT NULL

document_links.baseline_ddl:
source_id bigint NOT NULL,
    document_target_id bigint,
    relation text DEFAULT 'link'::text NOT NULL,
    quest_target_id bigint,
    character_target_id bigint,
    region_target_id bigint,
    target_type text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
CASE
    WHEN (document_target_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'document'::text
    WHEN (quest_target_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'quest'::text
    WHEN (character_target_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'character'::text
    ELSE 'region'::text
END) STORED NOT NULL,
    target_id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS (COALESCE(document_target_id, quest_target_id, character_target_id, region_target_id)) STORED NOT NULL,
    summary_append_order bigint NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT document_links_exactly_one_target CHECK ((num_nonnulls(document_target_id, quest_target_id, character_target_id, region_target_id) = 1))

    slots_max integer DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,

    genres text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[] NOT NULL,

    signup_type text,
    discord_desired_revision integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT quests_filled_count_check CHECK (((filled_count >= 0) AND (filled_count <= slots_max))),
